story.p1: I-{{full}} yathoma ngesikhathi sokuziqhenya. U-{{founder}} wabona abangani bakhe abaseduze bathoma amakampani wabo, begodu wazibonela bona kutlhogeka isibindi esingangani ukuthoma.
story.p2: Isikhathesi sahlala naye. Kade athanda ukusiza ama-SMME bona afikelele imigomo yawo, athuthuke begodu akhule, begodu bekafuna ukwakha into ezokuma nawo nawenza lokho.
story.p3: Ibizo mlayezo ebekafuna ukuwuthumela ebanganini bakhe abaseduze, nakiwo woke amabhizinisi neenhlangano ezilisebenzisako: niyakghona. Ragelani phambili nilwela, ningakhe niyeme.
story.title: Indaba yethu

about.tagline: I-CRM ehlanganisa ibhizinisi lakho, amakhasimende wakho nesiqhema sakho.

hero.body: Ukuqhuba ibhizinisi kutlhoga isibindi, ukuzimisela nokusebenza budisi. Ukuliphatha akukafaneli kwenze ikambo libe budisi khulu. Sakha amathulusi alula, akhanyako bona ugxile kokuqakathekileko: ukwakha into enomnqopho.

mission.title: Umnqopho wethu
mission.body: Ukunikela amabhizinisi ithekhnoloji efikelelekako, ethembekileko nehlakaniphileko eyenza umsebenzi ube bulula, ikhulise ukukhiqiza begodu isekele ukukhula okuhlala isikhathi eside.

vision.title: Umbono wethu
vision.body: Ukuba mlingani wethekhnoloji othembekileko wamabhizinisi kilo loke iSewula Afrika nangaphetjheya, sisiza osomabhizinisi bona baguqule amaphupho wabo abe mabhizinisi ahlala isikhathi eside.

grow.title: Khula
grow.body: Yakha ubuhlobo obuqinileko namakhasimende, ufumane amathuba amatjha begodu uqhubekisele phambili ukuthengisa ngokuqala okukhanyako kwepayipi lakho.

manage.title: Phatha
manage.body: Gcina umsebenzi wakho wamalanga woke ndawonye: amakhasimende, iinlinganiso, ama-invoyisi, imikhiqizo, imisebenzi nemilayezo.

succeed.title: Phumelela
succeed.body: Hlala wazi, wenze iinqunto ezingcono begodu uqhubeke uya emigomeni yakho. Ipumelelo iyahlukana ebhizinisini ngalinye; i-YGT ikusiza ugxile kweyakho.

builtFor.title: Yakhelwe amabhizinisi wabo boke ubukhulu
builtFor.body: Nanyana uthoma ibhizinisi lakho lokuthoma, uphatha ikampani ekhulako namkha uhola isiqhema esikhulu, i-YGT yakhelwe ukusekela ikambo lakho. Amathulusi anamandla webhizinisi kufanele asebenzeke begodu afikeleleke, angagcinelwa iinhlangano ezikhulu kwaphela.

simplicity.title: Ubulula
simplicity.body: Ithekhnoloji kufanele yenze ipilo ibe bulula.

accessibility.title: Ukufikeleleka
accessibility.body: Amathulusi webhizinisi anesizo kufanele afikeleleke kibo boke abantu.

innovation.title: Ukusungula
innovation.body: Siraga sifumana iindlela ezihlakaniphileko zokurarulula iintjhijilo zamalanga woke.

empowerment.title: Ukunikela amandla
empowerment.body: Sisiza osomabhizinisi benze izinto ngokuzithemba begodu baraga bakhula.

sa.title: ISewula Afrika ekhanyako neqinileko
sa.body: Osomabhizinisi beSewula Afrika babhekene neentjhijilo zabo. I-YGT iletha amathulusi asebenzako neendlela zokusebenza ezifanele amabhizinisi wekhaya, ngawo woke amalimi asemthethweni ali-11, bona uphikisane, ukhule begodu uphumelele emnothweni wedijithali.

promise.title: Ikambo lakho. Ukuzibophelela kwethu.

channels.smsIntro: Thumela begodu wamukele ama-SMS nge-akhawunti yakho kumhlinzeki we-SMS. Ubhadela umhlinzeki ngqo ngemilayezo.

smsSteps.account: Vula i-akhawunti ku-BulkSMS, Clickatell namkha Twilio bese uthenga ikhredithi.
smsSteps.keys: Yenza iinkhiya ze-API edetjhibhodini yomhlinzeki bese uzinamathisela ngaphasi.
smsSteps.sender: Engeza i-ID yomthumeli namkha inomboro evunyelwe mhlinzeki wakho (amanethiwekhi amanengi weSewula Afrika atlhoga i-ID yomthumeli etloliswe).
smsSteps.webhook: Bulunga, hlola ngenomboro yakho, bese ubeka i-webhook URL etjengiswe ngaphasi njengekheli le-SMS engenako lomhlinzeki.

webhookHelp.sms: Edetjhibhodini yomhlinzeki wakho we-SMS, beka lokhu njengekheli lemilayezo engenako (inbound / reply webhook) bona iimpendulo zifike ku-YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Namathisela lokhu ku-Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, bese utlolisela "messages". Yindlela iimpendulo zamakhasimende ezifika ngayo ku-YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Hlanganisa inomboro yakho ye-WhatsApp Business nge-Cloud API esemthethweni ye-Meta. Imilayezo iphuma enomborweni yakho begodu iimpendulo zingena ku-Imilayezo.

whatsappSteps.app: Iya ku-developers.facebook.com, yenza i-app yohlobo lwe-Business bese wengeza umkhiqizo we-WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Ngaphasi kwe-WhatsApp > API Setup, engeza inomboro yomtato yebhizinisi lakho bese ukopa i-Phone number ID ne-WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Kunamathisele ngaphasi, tshwaya "Sebenzisa i-WhatsApp", bulunga, bese uhlola ngenomboro yakho yeselula.
whatsappSteps.token: Ku-Business Settings > System users, yenza i-access token ehlala njalo enemvumo ye-whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Kopa i-webhook URL ne-verify token okutjengiswa ngemva kokubulunga eenlungiselelweni ze-webhook ze-Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Umthetho we-WhatsApp: ungaphendula ngokukhululeka amawura ama-24 ngemva kobana ikhasimende likuthumelele umlayezo; ukuthoma ikulumiswano ngemva kwalokho kutlhoga i-template evunyelwe yi-Meta.

activities.a1: Vula isivumelwano namkha ikhasimende bese uqhwarhaza u-Hlela, namkha usebenzise imisebenzi erhabako (Ikhwalo, I-imeyili, Umhlangano) ngaphezulu ekhasini labo.
activities.a2: Asinawo umsebenzi ovulekileko. Iinvumelwano ezingenagadango elilandelako zivamise ukuphola, ngalokho hlela linye.

activities.p2: Tjhugulula phakathi kwemisebenzi yakho neyawo woke umuntu
activities.p3: Inomboro ebomvu kumenyu ibala okudlulelwe sikhathi namkha okufanele namhlanje
activities.summary: Iingcingo, imihlangano, imisebenzi namalanga wokuphela: amagadango alandelako eenvumelwaneni namakhasimendeni woke.
activities.title: Imisebenzi

charts.p1: Iphayiphi ngesigaba: ibalelo leenvumelwano ezivulekileko egadangweni ngalinye
charts.p2: Imali ebuthelelweko: iimbhadelo ezamukelweko inyanga ngayinye
charts.p3: Iinkolodo: okusesele nokobana kungangani okudlulelwe sikhathi
charts.summary: Amatjhadi amabili atjengisa bona imali yakho ivelaphi.
charts.title: Iphayiphi nemali

customers.a1: Iye. Umphathi angengeza iindawo ezifana ne-Ibubulo ku-Iinlungiselelo > Iindawo ezengezelelweko.
customers.p1: Abathintanako, iinvumelwano, iinlinganiso nama-invoyisi ekhasimendeni ngalinye
customers.p2: Umlando wesikhathi wayo yoke i-imeyili, inothi, ikhwalo nembhadelo
customers.summary: Amabhizinisi nabantu obathengisela, nomlando wabo woke endaweni yinye.
customers.title: Amakhasimende

dashboard.a1: Ziyazala njengombana wengeza iinvumelwano begodu utlola iimbhadelo. Izinga lokuphumelela litlhoga okungenani isivumelwano esisodwa esiphumeleleko namkha esilahlekileko.
dashboard.a2: Iye. Qhwarhaza nanyana yiyiphi inomboro namkha isihloko sephaneli bona uvule irhelo elingemva kwayo.
dashboard.p1: Iinomboro eziqakathekileko: iphayiphi evulekileko, iinvumelwano eziphumeleleko kunyanga le, izinga lokuphumelela nobukhulu besivumelwano obujayelekileko
dashboard.p2: Amatjhadi: ibalelo lephayiphi ngesigaba nemali ebuthelelweko ngeenyangeni ezisithandathu
dashboard.p3: Ilanga lakho: iingcingo, imihlangano nemisebenzi efaneleko namhlanje namkha edlulelwe sikhathi
dashboard.p4: Imali okweledwa yona, iinvumelwano zakho ezikulu ezivulekileko nemisebenzi yakwanje
dashboard.summary: Isikrini sakho sekhaya: bona ukuthengisa kukhamba njani, okufanele ukwenze namhlanje, nalokho okweledwa khona.
dashboard.title: Idetjhibhodi

day.p3: Qhwarhaza ibizo bona uvule ikhasimende namkha isivumelwano
day.summary: Koke obekuhlelele ukukwenza namhlanje, kanye nanyana yini edlulelwe sikhathi.
day.title: Ilanga lakho

deals.a1: Sidosele ku-Siphumelele namkha Silahlekile ebhodweni, namkha usebenzise iinkinobho ekhasini lesivumelwano. Iinvumelwano ezilahlekileko zibuza bona kubayini, lokho kukusiza bona ufunde.
deals.a2: Qhwarhaza u-Isivumelwano esitja, khetha ikhasimende bese uzalisa ibalelo. Ibubulo izaliswa ivela ekhasimendeni nayaziwa.
deals.p1: Ukubuka ibhodo: dosa isivumelwano usuka esigabeni uye kesinye
deals.p2: Ukubuka irhelo: hlela bese ubuka zoke iinvumelwano
deals.p3: Isivumelwano ngasinye sitjengisa ibalelo, umnikazi, ibubulo negadango elilandelako
deals.q1: Ngisitshwaya njani isivumelwano njengesiphumeleleko namkha esilahlekileko?
deals.summary: Iphayiphi yakho yokuthengisa: woke amathuba nesigaba akiso.

customers.problem: Imininingwana yamakhasimende wakho isabalele ku-{{tools}}, ngalokho ukufumana inomboro efaneleko namkha umlando kuthatha isikhathi.
customers.fix: Irherho elilodwa lamakhasimende elinabo boke abathintana nabo, iinlinganiso, ama-invoyisi neenkulumo, isiqhema sakho soke esingarhubhulula kilo.

problem.memory: Imibuzo yamakhasimende ihlala ehlokweni lakho, ngalokho nakumatasa, eminye iyaphola ngaphambi kobana kulandelelwe.
problem.whatsapp: Imibuzo ibulungelwe eenkulumweni ze-WhatsApp, ngalokho kubudisi ukubona okulindileko namkha bona ngamunye uqakatheke kangangani.
problem.excel: Imibuzo isesipredishithini okufanele umuntu asibuyekeze, begodu eminye isaphunyuka.
problem.crm: Uyayilandelela imibuzo, kodwana eminye isaphunyuka ngaphambi kobana ibe msebenzi.

pipeline.fix: Umgqa wokuthengisa otjengisa woke umbuzo kusukela emlayezweni wokuthoma bekube msebenzi ophumeleleko, kanye negadango elilandelako nenani lawo.

tasks.problem: Ukulandelela kuthembele ku-{{tools}}. Nangabe umuntu umatasa namkha akekho, izinto ziyaphuthelwa.
tasks.fix: Imisebenzi enamalanga wokugcina, amarherho wokuhlola neenkhumbuzo, enikelwe umuntu ofaneleko bona kungabi nokuthembele ekumbulweni.

documents.problem: Iinlinganiso nama-invoyisi kwenziwa ku-{{tools}}: kutlolwa ngesandla, kunikelwa iinomboro ngesandla, begodu kubudisi ukukulandelela.
documents.fix: Iinlinganiso ezisezingeni eliphezulu ngemizuzu ezitjhuguluka zibe ma-invoyisi ngokuqhwarhaza kanye, ne-VAT, iinomboro nophawu lwakho kwenzelwe wena.

problem.rarely: Iinkhokhelo ezidlule isikhathi azijayelekanga, kodwana akukho okuziqalileko, ngalokho enye ingahlala iinyanga.
problem.manual: Ulandela ababhadela sekudlule isikhathi wena, ucingo namkha umlayezo munye ngesikhathi. Kudla amahora neenkulumo ezingathabisiko.
problem.remember: Ababhadela sekudlule isikhathi balandelwa kwaphela nawukhumbulako, ngalokho imali oyisebenzeleko ihlala ingakabhadelwa.
problem.automatic: Iinkhokhelo ziyalandelelwa, kodwana kubudisi ukubona msinyana bona ngubani okukweletako malini.

payments.fix: Bona msinyana bona ngubani okukweletako, bese uvumela iinkhumbuzo ezizenzakalelako zilandelele ama-invoyisi adlulelwe sikhathi.

report.noGaps: Azikho iinkhala ezikulu ezitholakeleko. Wenze kuhle.
report.how: Kulinganisela, ingasi isithembiso, okusekelwe emiphendulweni yakho kwaphela. Isilinganiso ngasinye namkha i-invoyisi kuthatha imizuzu ema-8 ukuya kema-25 kuya ngokuthi kwenziwa kuphi, nakumadaniswa nemizuzu eli-{{ygt}} ukuya kweli-{{lowYgt}} nge-{{name}}. Ukulandela i-invoyisi edlule isikhathi ngesandla kuthatha imizuzu engaba li-{{chase}}. Ukukopisha hlangana namathulusi angakahlanganiswa kudla amahora afika ku-{{switching}} ngenyanga umuntu ngamunye ethulusini ngalinye ngemva kwamabili, kancani nange amathulusi wakho ahlanganiswe kancani begodu akudli litho nange ayasebenzisana; okhunye ukukopisha kusala nange-{{name}}. Ukuqala izinto kubalwa ngokwehlukileko, ngalokho akukho umzuzu obalwa kabili. Isikhathi sokuqala sikhula nenani labantu abenza ukuphatha, kodwana kancani kunesiqhema. Iphezulu lobubanzi sikhathi sakho nje kususwa isikhathi esilinganiselwe nge-{{name}}; iphasi licabanga bona udlulisela pheze ingcenye, ngemizuzu eli-{{lowYgt}} umtlolo ngamunye. Ithulusi ngalinye elingakahlanganiswa ngemva kwa-{{ok}} lidla amaphuzu afika kwama-2, begodu amaphuzu athoma ku-0 ukuya ku-100.
report.trialTitle: Sewulungele ukwenza ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho kube lula?
report.trialBody: Sewubonile lapho iinkqubo zakho zingathuthuka khona. Linga i-{{name}} simahla iinsuku ezili-{{days}} ubeke koke endaweni yinye. Akutlhogeki ikarada, ungakhansela nanyana kunini.
report.worthNote: Ngenani lakho lehora. Leli linani lesikhathi esikhululiweko, ingasi umrholo owengezelelekileko oqinisekisiweko namkha imali ebulungiweko. Imiphumela yakho ixhomekeke ekutheni udlulisela umsebenzi wakho omnengi kangangani.
report.toolsConnected: Uthe amathulusi wakho ayasebenzisana, ngalokho inani lamathulusi alikudli amaphuzu.

prospects.name: Ibizo namkha ibizo lebhizinisi
prospects.addNote: Amakhasimende angaba khona awawatholi amatjhugulo wakho bekube avuma ukuzwa kuwe.
prospects.lawNote: Umthetho weSewula Afrika (i-POPIA) ukuvumela bona uthumele ukuthengisa emakhasimendeni angaba khona kwaphela nange sele avumile. Maka "Uvumile ukuthengisa" nange umuntu athi iye, namkha uthumele isimemo sesikhathi sinye bona ubabuze. Boke abavumako bajoyina abalaleli bamatjhugulo wakho.
prospects.emptyHint: Engeza abantu namabhizinisi ofuna ukuwazuza. Amakhasimende angaba khona avela ephayiphini lakho naku-Discovery nawo avela lapha.
prospects.invitedOn: Isimemo sithunyelwe ngo-{{date}}. Silindele ipendulo yabo.
prospects.declinedHint: Bathe awa namkha bazikhiphile, ngalokho angekhe bathole ama-imeyili wokuthengisa.
prospects.agreeIntro: Tlola bona u-{{name}} uvume njani ukuzwa kuwe. Kucacise: bufakazi bakho nange umuntu abuza.
prospects.howAgreedHint: Isibonelo: uthe iye ngefowuni ngo-29 kuSewula.
prospects.inviteMessage:
Lotjhani {name},

Ngikutlolela ngivela ku-{{company}}. Singathanda ukwabelana nawe ngeendaba ezisizako, amaphuzu neenzuzo ngesikhathi esithileko.

Ungathanda ukuzwa kithi? Thinta "Yes, keep me posted" ngaphasi. Nange kungasinjalo, akunankinga namanje.
prospects.inviteOnce: Ungabuza u-{{email}} kanye kwaphela. Ipendulo yabo itlolwa ngokuzenzakalela nange bathinta Iye namkha Awa.
prospects.subject: Isihloko
prospects.messageHint: Sebenzisa u-{name} ebizweni labo lokuthoma. Buza bona bangathanda ukuzwa kuwe, ubulunge iinzuzo bekube bathi iye.
prospects.inviteAdds: Sengeza ikinobho ethi "Yes, keep me posted", isihlanganisi esithi "No thanks" nomugqa othi "We won't email you again unless you say yes."

consent.title: I-YGT ingakuthumelela amathiphu, iindaba neenzuzo?

consent.savedYes: Siyathokoza! Ungakutjhugulula lokhu kuphrofayili yakho nanyana kunini.
